accepted: Promoter-specific rather than genome-wide distal exclusion.
Exact hg19->hg38->hg19 C3 round-trip requirement with zero tolerance.
Side drawn before admissibility and no opposite-side retry.
Anchor frequency restored to distinct-promoter interval-overlap definition.
No proposal lattice; candidate starts treated as integer intervals.
No retention target and Phase B remains stopped.

B1_second_control_independence_and_prima.finding: The contract adds a new requirement that CONTROL_A and CONTROL_B be non-identical and says that if only one passes the hg38 gate 'the edge retains that one'. The frozen design only requires a second independent draw reserved for the control-vs-control null; it does not require conditioning the second draw on being different, and CONTROL_B may never substitute for CONTROL_A in the primary contrast.
B1_second_control_independence_and_prima.consequence: Forcing non-identity changes the second-draw distribution. Allowing B to rescue a failed A changes the primary control-selection rule and makes the primary depend on the availability of the null arm.
required: Draw CONTROL_A and CONTROL_B independently from distinct deterministic sub-seeds, without conditioning B on A != B. If they coincide, record the coincidence; do not redraw unless a prospectively frozen successor explicitly defines that.
Primary retention depends only on CONTROL_A. If A has no admissible control on its drawn side, the linked edge is trimmed from the primary even if B succeeds.
If A succeeds and B fails, retain the edge for the primary but mark control-vs-control null unavailable for that edge.
CONTROL_B can never enter the primary contrast.

B2_hg19_PU1_prefilter_not_yet_proven_los.finding: K adds overlap with a reverse-lifted hg19 PU.1 track as a proposal-space filter. The frozen biological rule is hg38 PU.1 overlap AFTER exact C3 lifting. The original contract does not include a hg19 PU.1 prefilter, and B_S is already finite, so K is not required to make the universe finite.
B2_hg19_PU1_prefilter_not_yet_proven_los.consequence: Unless losslessness is proved, K can exclude hg19 starts whose exact-roundtrip hg38 controls would pass the authoritative hg38 PU.1 gate, silently narrowing the frozen admissible universe.
B2_hg19_PU1_prefilter_not_yet_proven_los.required: Either remove K from the admissible-universe definition and define the final admissible integer starts solely by the frozen post-liftover gates, OR provide and test a formal/empirical losslessness equivalence: for every candidate satisfying distance/exclusion and exact C3 round-trip, hg38 PU.1 overlap iff its hg19 start lies in K. Matching peak counts alone is insufficient because different chain offsets can alter interval-overlap relationships.

B3_stage3_population_schema_mismatch.finding: Canonical V64_NIH_CARD_STAGE3_FEATURE_ARTIFACT_CONTRACT_V1 freezes population as LINKED or CONTROL. The successor contract introduces population labels CONTROL_A and CONTROL_B.
B3_stage3_population_schema_mismatch.required: Preserve population=CONTROL for both and add a separate control_role=A|B field (or freeze an explicit schema successor before execution). Do not silently change the existing population enum.

B4_data_dependent_stop_condition.finding: STOP_CONDITIONS says an empty exact interval sampler for a majority of edges would indicate 'the universe definition itself is wrong rather than the data being sparse'. That conclusion is data-dependent and not logically guaranteed.
B4_data_dependent_stop_condition.consequence: A real low-support result could trigger redesign merely because it is surprising.
B4_data_dependent_stop_condition.required: Remove this stop/reinterpretation rule. A high empty-side/control rate is a result to report. Stop only on implementation inconsistency, violated invariants, or failure of the prospectively defined construction.

additional_guidance.candidate_universe: The scientifically authoritative admissible set is the set of integer hg19 starts satisfying frozen distance/side/promoter-specific exclusion whose 5-kb windows pass exact C3 round-trip and then the hg38 PU.1 + NIH-CARD consensus gates. Any proposal-space acceleration must be proven lossless relative to that set.
additional_guidance.sampling: Uniformity must be over the final admissible starts for the drawn side, not over a convenience proposal subset unless equivalence is established.
